wgan_model_contract.model_family: WGAN neural-CDE neural-SDE comparator, operationalized as a conditional WGAN-GP with a Neural-CDE generator and a conditional path critic

generator.initial_state: Two-hidden-layer MLP with 64 SiLU units per hidden layer mapping [four normalized context features, 32-dimensional static latent] to the 64-dimensional CDE hidden state.
generator.vector_field: Two-hidden-layer MLP with 64 SiLU units per hidden layer mapping the hidden state to a 64 x 3 control-vector field; no recurrent cell, attention, convolution, or adaptive solver.
generator.control_increment: At each of 63 intervals, delta_control = [dt, sqrt(dt) * epsilon_1, sqrt(dt) * epsilon_2], with epsilon channels sampled standard normal and piecewise-linear control between grid points.
generator.integration: Fixed explicit Euler controlled differential update over 63 intervals; dt=1/252; no adaptive step size and no hidden-state clamp.
generator.readout: Two-hidden-layer MLP with 64 SiLU units per hidden layer mapping [hidden state, unchanged normalized context] to one unconstrained daily log-return increment.
generator.output: A 63-element daily log-return increment path; cumulative sums are derived only for path diagnostics and critic control.

critic.initial_state: Two-hidden-layer MLP with 64 SiLU units per hidden layer mapping the four normalized context features to a 64-dimensional hidden state.
critic.vector_field: Two-hidden-layer MLP with 64 SiLU units per hidden layer mapping the hidden state to a 64 x 6 control-vector field.
critic.integration: The same fixed explicit Euler controlled differential grid of 63 intervals and dt=1/252.
critic.readout: One linear scalar output from the terminal hidden state; no sigmoid, softmax, or probability calibration.
critic.real_fake_input: The critic receives either the real target daily log-return path or the generated daily log-return path, paired with the same context representation.

conditioning.source: The strictly preceding 22 daily log returns only; target and future returns are excluded.
conditioning.normalization: Per-feature z-score normalizer fitted on training-derived windows only; the frozen normalizer is reused for fit, internal selection, and internal Gate evaluation.

path_representation.source_returns: Daily log returns from the frozen SPY training series.
path_representation.critic_path_channel: Cumulative target/generated log return divided by the training-fit cumulative-return scale, with time and broadcast context.
path_representation.price_level: Not generated and not used as a learned output.

latent_noise.static_distribution: independent standard normal vector per generated path
latent_noise.temporal_distribution: independent standard normal increments per interval, scaled by sqrt(dt) in the CDE control
latent_noise.training_seed_source: data_seed for training noise and shuffled-window order
latent_noise.evaluation_seed_source: common fixed eval_seed=8283 for post-training generation; it is not an independent training replicate

normalization_policy.path_scale: training-only cumulative-return scale equal to training daily-return standard deviation times sqrt(horizon)
normalization_policy.network_normalization: no batch normalization, layer normalization, spectral normalization, or other learned normalization
normalization_policy.output: raw daily log returns; no post-hoc output rescaling

adversarial_objective.name: WGAN-GP
adversarial_objective.gradient_penalty: For uniformly interpolated real/fake paths, penalize (L2 norm of critic gradient with respect to the full path input minus 1)^2; context is held fixed for the interpolation.

optimizer.gradient_clipping: none; gradient penalty is the preregistered Lipschitz enforcement

early_stopping.selection_data: internal selection tail of the training split only

maximum_training.no_wall_clock_cap: The frozen v1 protocol defines no wall-clock/GPU-time cap; deterministic update/example counts are the proxy.

checkpoint_selection.definition: The existing Gate-v2 normalized one-dimensional Wasserstein discrepancy between generated terminal returns and the 1024-path circular moving-block-bootstrap reference from the internal selection tail, normalized by the real bootstrap terminal standard deviation.
checkpoint_selection.tie_break: earliest generator epoch; if still identical, lexicographically smallest member/config identity
checkpoint_selection.refit: After selection, refit the selected contract on all eligible training windows for exactly the selected best_generator_epoch, without any new metric, validation observation, or hyperparameter choice.

wgan_model_contract.weight_initialization: PyTorch Linear default reset_parameters semantics for every Linear layer; no post-initialization re-seeding or result-dependent initialization.

determinism.python_numpy_torch_seeds: Bound to the frozen member seed tuple.

wgan_model_contract.contract_verdict: MINIMUM_EXECUTABLE RESEARCH-GRADE CONTRACT FROZEN BEFORE WGAN RESULTS

selection_split.construction: Chronologically first floor(0.8 * eligible_windows) fit windows, then the remaining tail windows whose target intervals begin after the final fit target interval; intervening windows are an embargo gap.
selection_split.target_overlap: prohibited between fit and selection subsets

internal_evaluation_gate.wgan_gate_adaptation: Use only architecture-neutral path criteria: finite output, variance ratio [0.50, 2.00], terminal dispersion ratio [0.50, 2.00], path uniqueness >= 0.99, and return ACF(1) absolute difference <= 0.25. Do not fabricate a WGAN drift/diffusion decomposition.

status_vocabulary.H2_SUPPORTED: The preregistered descriptive dominance rule supports the original direction.
status_vocabulary.H2_NOT_SUPPORTED: The preregistered rule is evaluable but the signature-score family does not dominate the WGAN family.
status_vocabulary.H2_UNRESOLVED: The rule cannot be evaluated because a required family is underfilled, a required metric is missing/nonfinite, or governance validity is incomplete.

primary_rule.family_a: Validated five-member Neural-SDE family from Amendment 057: seed-01, seed-02, seed-04, seed-05, reserve-j01.
primary_rule.family_b: Five WGAN primary members wgan-seed-01 through wgan-seed-05; only GATE_PASS_VALID and GATE_FAIL_VALID count as valid completed members.
primary_rule.aggregation: For each family and each metric, use the five valid completed member values in fixed roster order; report arithmetic mean, sample SD ddof=1, median, minimum, maximum, and no weights.
primary_rule.comparison: Compare the Neural-SDE and WGAN family values only on the four preregistered cross-family primary metrics, using each metric's frozen direction. Do not form a composite score, rank, post-hoc subset, or weighted aggregate.
primary_rule.supported: H2_SUPPORTED iff both families have exactly five valid completed members, every primary metric is finite for both families, the Neural-SDE family is no worse than WGAN on every primary metric, and Neural-SDE is strictly better on at least one primary metric.
primary_rule.not_supported: H2_NOT_SUPPORTED iff both families have five valid completed members and complete primary metrics, but the supported condition is false, including any WGAN strict improvement or any mixed/incomparable primary direction.
primary_rule.unresolved: H2_UNRESOLVED iff either family has fewer than five valid completed members, any primary metric is missing/nonfinite, or a governance-invalid/missing Gate prevents the required family summary. A comparator failure is not converted into H2 support by default.

h2_decision_rule.secondary_evidence: Architecture-neutral path-quality diagnostics are reported with direction and uncertainty summaries but cannot change H2 status.
h2_decision_rule.missingness: No imputation, replacement, or result-contingent reserve execution.
h2_decision_rule.failure_handling: Valid poor WGAN models remain included; invalid executions remain in failure accounting but do not count as completed members.
h2_decision_rule.significance: No statistical significance test, p-value, confidence interval, Holm procedure, or inferential threshold is introduced for this n=5 descriptive H2 stability comparison. The original paired/dependence-aware rule remains applicable to the separately governed hedging endpoint; H2 limitations are reported explicitly.
h2_decision_rule.seed_only_attribution: No claim that any observed difference is seed-only.
h2_decision_rule.decision_verdict: DESCRIPTIVE EFFECT-DIRECTION RULE FROZEN; NO POST-HOC COMPOSITE OR SIGNIFICANCE TEST
